notes: Version 2.34 records the Q6a 2.3 cycle (Q6a 2.3, Foundation 2.3, GS-Note 2.2, Q12 1.7, Q6b 2.1). Q6a reads SU(2) off the spinor carrier supplied by O23, under the neutral-sector hypothesis of O27: the group acting faithfully on that carrier is SU(2), a consistency statement and not a selection, and no uniqueness or minimality of SU(2) is established. The Foundation axioms do not select the carrier, and Foundation lists the SU(2) gauge structure as conditional. Q6a's connection is conditional on two continuum hypotheses, one of them the spatial continuum that Q5a leaves open, and the Yang–Mills action is a structural motivation. The graph edge Q5b -> Q6a is replaced by a conditional edge Q5a -> Q6a, since Q6a cites Q5a and not Q5b. Entries for O31, O32, Q5a, U1, W1 and H2 state their current content without narrating earlier versions.
